exams.name: Surety Bail Bond Agent Written Examination
exams.notes: Commissioner may designate an independent testing service to prepare and administer the examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Insurance Commissioner) or designated independent testing service
exams.quote: An applicant for a license shall be required to appear in person and take a written examination testing the applicant's competency and qualifications to act as a surety bail bond agent.

interval_years.quote: Such license shall expire on January thirty-first of each even-numbered year.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: each person licensed as a surety bail bond agent in this state shall, on or before January thirty-first, annually, pay to the commissioner a fee of four hundred fifty dollars to cover the cost of examinations under this subsection.

required.quote: The commissioner may adopt regulations, in accordance with the provisions of chapter 54, to (1) implement the provisions of section 38a-660 and sections 38a-660b to 38a-660k, inclusive, and (2) establish continuing education requirements for persons licensed as surety bail bond agents in this state.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a surety bail bond agent license issued by the commissioner to a qualified individual as provided in this section

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not in this state solicit or negotiate in respect to execution or delivery of an undertaking of bail or bail bond on behalf of an insurer, or execute or deliver such an undertaking of bail or bail bond on behalf of an insurer unless licensed as provided in this section.

title_protection.quote: No person shall represent to the public that such person has the authority to represent an insurer as its surety bail bond agent until such person has been appointed by an insurer as such agent in accordance with this section.

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not in this state solicit or negotiate in respect to execution or delivery of an undertaking of bail or bail bond on behalf of an insurer, or execute or deliver such an undertaking of bail or bail bond on behalf of an insurer unless licensed as provided in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has violated any of the terms or provisions of sections 38a-660 and 38a-660b to 38a-660k or any regulations adopted thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commissioner may suspend or revoke the license of a surety bail bond agent, or may impose a fine in lieu of or in addition to such suspension or revocation in accordance with section 38a-774 for any violation of section 38a-660 and sections 38a-660b to 38a-660k, inclusive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing of a false certification by a surety bail bond agent regarding premium rates charged.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The filing of a false certification by a surety bail bond agent shall be grounds for administrative action in accordance with section 38a-774.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any surety bail bond agent who diverts or appropriates funds received in a fiduciary capacity for personal use.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any surety bail bond agent who diverts or appropriates any of the funds received under subsection (a) of this section for such agent's own use shall be subject to the penalties for larceny

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suggesting or advising the employment of a particular attorney in exchange for a fee or other consideration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suggest or advise, in exchange for a fee or other consideration, the employment of or name for employment of any particular attorney to represent the principal on a bail bond

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting business in or on the property or grounds of a correctional institution, detention facility, or courthouse except as permitted.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicit business in or on the property or grounds of a correctional institution, community correctional center or other detention facility where arrested persons are confined, or in or on the property or grounds of any courthouse, unless a request is initiated by an arrested person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee or rebate or giving anything of value to a law enforcement officer or other public official to secure a compromise or reduction of a bail bond or estreatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to a law enforcement officer, judicial marshal, employee of the Department of Correction or other person who has power to arrest or to hold a person in custody, or to any other public official or public employee, to secure a compromise, remission or reduction of the amount of any bail bond or estreatment of bail

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee or rebate or giving anything of value to an attorney in any matter pertaining to a bail bond, except in defense of any action on a bail bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to an attorney in any matter pertaining to a bail bond, except in defense of any action on a bail bond

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee or rebate or giving anything of value to the principal or to any person on the principal's behalf.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to the principal or to any person on the principal's behalf

disciplinary_grounds.description: Executing a bail bond in the state on the agent's or insurer's own behalf.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Execute a bail bond in this state on such agent's or insurer's own behalf

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writing a bail bond for an arrested person without written authorization from the arrested person or authorized representative.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Write a bail bond in this state for an arrested person if such arrested person or a person with actual or apparent authority to act on behalf of such arrested person has not authorized such agent, in writing, to execute a bail bond on such arrested person's behalf.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Executing a bail bond while an unpaid forfeiture judgment has remained unpaid for at least sixty days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a bail bond executed by a surety bail bond agent is forfeited and such forfeiture has remained unpaid for at least sixty days after the date payment has become due, no such surety bail bond agent or insurer that appointed such agent shall execute a bail bond in this state until the full amount of the forfeited bail bond is paid

agent_type_tiers.quote: No person shall, as a surety on a bond in a criminal proceeding or an agent of such surety, engage in the business of taking or attempting to take into custody the principal on the bond who has failed to appear in court and for whom a rearrest warrant or a capias has been issued pursuant to section 54-65a unless such person is licensed as a professional bondsman under chapter 533, a surety bail bond agent under chapter 700f or a bail enforcement agent under sections 29-152f to 29-152i, inclusive.

bail_enforcement_agent_license_available.quote: Any person desiring to engage in the business of a bail enforcement agent shall apply to the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection for a license therefor.

managing_general_agent_required.quote: "Managing general agent" means any person appointed or employed by an insurer to supervise or otherwise manage the bail bond business written in this state by surety bail bond agents appointed by such insurer

power_of_attorney_required.quote: "Surety bail bond agent" means any person who has been approved by the commissioner and appointed by an insurer by power of attorney to execute or countersign bail bonds for the insurer in connection with judicial proceedings.

premium_rate_filed_and_approved.quote: No surety bail bond agent shall execute a bail bond without charging the premium rate approved by the commissioner pursuant to chapter 701.

premium_financing_allowed.quote: A surety bail bond agent may enter into a premium financing arrangement with a principal or any indemnitor in which such agent extends credit to such principal or indemnitor.

premium_financing_minimum_down_payment_p.quote: such agent shall require (1) the principal on the bail bond or any indemnitor to make a minimum down payment of thirty-five per cent of the premium due

build_up_fund_allowed.quote: "Build-up funds" means a percentage of the premium received by a surety bail bond agent for the execution of a bail bond, which are held in a trust account by the insurer or managing general agent

collateral_receipt_required.quote: The surety bail bond agent shall provide to the person providing the collateral security or other indemnity a written, numbered receipt that describes in a detailed manner the collateral security or other indemnity provided, along with copies of any documents rendered

collateral_held_in_fiduciary_capacity.quote: The surety bail bond agent shall hold the collateral security or other indemnity in a fiduciary capacity and shall, prior to any forfeiture of a bail bond, keep the collateral security or other indemnity separate and apart from any other funds or assets of the surety bail bond agent

collateral_return_deadline_days.quote: the insurer, managing general agent or surety bail bond agent shall return the collateral security or other indemnity, except a promissory note or an indemnity agreement, not later than twenty-one days after receipt of a written report from the court that the bail bond has been terminated.

large_cash_collateral_threshold_and_hand.value: If cash collateral exceeds $50,000, it must be made payable to the insurer in the form of a cashier's check, U.S. postal money order, certificate of deposit, or wire transfer, and the entire amount must be promptly forwarded to the insurer or managing general agent.
large_cash_collateral_threshold_and_hand.quote: If the surety bail bond agent receives collateral security or other indemnity in excess of fifty thousand dollars in cash, the cash amount shall be made payable to the insurer in the form of a cashier's check, United States postal money order, certificate of deposit or wire transfer

value: Soliciting in or on property of a correctional institution, community correctional center, or other detention facility (except when request initiated by arrested person or authorized representative)
Soliciting in or on property of a courthouse (except when request initiated by arrested person or authorized representative or potential indemnitor)
solicitation_restrictions.quote: Solicit business in or on the property or grounds of a correctional institution, community correctional center or other detention facility where arrested persons are confined, or in or on the property or grounds of any courthouse, unless a request is initiated by an arrested person, a person with actual or apparent authority to act on behalf of such arrested person, or a potential indemnitor.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: Suggest or advise, in exchange for a fee or other consideration, the employment of or name for employment of any particular attorney to represent the principal on a bail bond

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to a law enforcement officer, judicial marshal, employee of the Department of Correction or other person who has power to arrest or to hold a person in custody, or to any other public official or public employee, to secure a compromise, remission or reduction of the amount of any bail bond or estreatment of bail

law_enforcement_prohibited_from_acting_a.quote: No person engaged in law enforcement or vested with police powers shall be licensed as a surety bail bond agent.

impersonation_of_government_official_pro.quote: No professional bondsman licensed under chapter 533, surety bail bond agent licensed under chapter 700f or bail enforcement agent licensed under sections 29-152f to 29-152i, inclusive, shall wear, carry or display any uniform, badge, shield or other insignia or emblems that purport to indicate that such bondsman or agent is an employee, officer or agent of the state or any political subdivision of the state or of the federal government.

firearm_permit_required_for_enforcement.quote: No professional bondsman licensed under chapter 533, surety bail bond agent licensed under chapter 700f or bail enforcement agent licensed under sections 29-152f to 29-152i, inclusive, shall carry a pistol, revolver or other firearm while engaging in the business of a professional bondsman, surety bail bond agent or bail enforcement agent, as the case may be, or while traveling to or from such business unless such bondsman or agent obtains a special permit from the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection

law_enforcement_notification_before_appr.quote: Prior to taking or attempting to take into custody the principal on a bond, a professional bondsman licensed under chapter 533, a surety bail bond agent licensed under chapter 700f or a bail enforcement agent licensed under sections 29-152f to 29-152i, inclusive, shall notify the police department or resident state trooper for, or state police troop having jurisdiction over, the municipality in which the principal is believed to be located of such bondsman's or agent's intentions.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: An insurer that terminates the appointment of a surety bail bond agent may (i) authorize such agent to take into custody a principal who has absconded for whom a bail bond had been executed prior to the termination of such agent's appointment, and (ii) seek discharge of forfeitures and judgments paid by such insurer on behalf of such agent prior to such agent's termination.

unpaid_forfeiture_judgment_limit.quote: If a bail bond executed by a surety bail bond agent is forfeited and such forfeiture has remained unpaid for at least sixty days after the date payment has become due, no such surety bail bond agent or insurer that appointed such agent shall execute a bail bond in this state until the full amount of the forfeited bail bond is paid to the Office of the Chief State's Attorney

quarterly_bond_reporting_required.quote: Each insurer and each surety bail bond agent that executes bail bonds in this state shall maintain and transmit the following records, based on such insurer's or such agent's Connecticut bail bond business, to the Insurance Department upon request

record_retention_period_years.quote: A surety bail bond agent shall preserve the books, accounts and records pertaining to a premium payment for at least three years after making such payment.

premium_trust_account_required.quote: All premiums, including any part of a premium that a surety bail bond agent is obligated to return to a principal or indemnitor, and other funds belonging to insurers or others that are received by a surety bail bond agent in performing such agent's duties as a surety bail bond agent shall be deemed trust funds received by such agent in a fiduciary capacity.
